weaponGroups.label: Sword + shield
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: Keep sword and shield in their established hands. Shield is a real equipped shield, not any arbitrary offhand item. Two independent silhouettes; sword tips clear the shield.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Shield stays toward screen-right; heavy options use shield bash or sword leverage only when action identity permits; otherwise use the selected heavy sword cut.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Forward shield guard; never place a conjured second weapon in the shield hand.

weaponGroups.label: Greatsword
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: Both hands hold the same long hilt; body rotation and rear heel transmit weight. Preserve full blade, helmet and cape clearance.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Heavy downward or diagonal cut with credible shoulder/hip load; no thin-rapier wrist flick.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Two-hand crossguard or blade-line defense; no invented shield.

weaponGroups.label: Staff
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: Keep staff length, tip and grip readable. Melee and casting grips differ; established casting may use one-hand staff plus existing book only when loadout-compatible.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Physical heavy staff blow uses a supported two-hand lever; magical smash is a staff-focused discharge with altered channel pose.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Staff intercept uses shaft placement and rear-foot brace; spell ward uses focus and grip without adding gear.

weaponGroups.label: Bow
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: Preserve bow limbs, string, arrow and finger clearance. Lower or safely release draw during collapse; no string passes through the torso.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Proposed semantic mapping: forceful braced shot, distinct from normal aimed release; needs explicit action-identity review. Never smash a bow into the ground or invent a melee weapon.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Physical defense favors displacement and bow protection; do not present bow limbs as a heavy shield.

weaponGroups.label: Single dagger
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: Exactly one equipped dagger; empty offhand remains empty. Use close elbow/hip geometry rather than a long-weapon arc.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Short committed stab or descending close cut; distinguish body drive from ordinary light knife strike.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Blade deflection supported by footwork; no second dagger or invisible shield.

weaponGroups.label: Dual daggers
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: Exactly two equipped daggers, one per hand. Separate both blade tips and wrists; crossed guards must not fuse hands.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Paired descending commitment or staggered heavy close strikes; two hands stay anatomically distinct.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Cross or staggered blade interception, followed by a hand-specific return.

weaponGroups.label: Single sword
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: One-hand sword read; empty offhand balances unless the selected item requires a two-hand grip. Do not relabel greatsword art.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Committed diagonal or descending cut driven from hips, keeping sword length appropriate to item.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Forward sword line, beat or bind with a clear empty offhand.

weaponGroups.label: Spear
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: Distinct straight point and long shaft; rear hand drives and front hand guides. No axe head or generic greatsword substitute.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Heavy braced thrust or controlled shaft-down finish; do not pretend a spear has a halberd blade.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Point-line interception or shaft deflection; retain space between hands and keep point toward screen-right.

weaponGroups.label: Halberd
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: Show axe head, top point and rear hook in the correct orientation. Two-hand leverage and complete head clearance matter.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Heavy diagonal head chop or controlled hook-and-drive where action identity permits; no staff tip replacement.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Long shaft barrier or head-line bind; keep the axe head distinct from spear geometry.

weaponGroups.label: Unarmed
weaponGroups.anatomyAndEquipment: Empty hands stay empty. Distinct fists, palms, elbows and knee silhouettes; no conjured staff or weapon disguised as equipment.
weaponGroups.heavyActionDirection: Committed hammerfist, elbow or palm drive with hip load; never add an impact tool.
weaponGroups.defenseDirection: Forearm cover, open-palm redirection or footwork; physical ranged retaliation has no presumed projectile.

magicRule.spellIdentitySource: Existing resolved card/spell identity, not invented class-school assignment.
magicRule.heldStanceRule: Change weight, torso/grip/hand configuration and sustained focus; keep effects separately removable.
magicRule.sequenceRule: Use channel, release and recovery choreography appropriate to the same weapon; do not recolor a physical impact and call it new animation.

rangedCounterOpenDecision.question: Does ranged mean a ranged retaliatory payload or a counter against incoming ranged attacks?
rangedCounterOpenDecision.currentAuthoringRule: Bow supports a ranged physical reply. Non-bow physical packages remain pending; no thrown swords, invented bows or presumed projectile skills. Evade/intercept plus melee return is a separate interpretation requiring action-identity decision.
rangedCounterOpenDecision.fallbackRule: Retain a reviewed registered action only if later runtime routing supports it; no art-only document promises fallback correctness.
